question: How many orders were placed on 2017-06-30, the last day of the 'Summer Beverages 2017' window in the marketing calendar? Return an integer.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders o WHERE date(o.OrderDate) = '2017-06-30'

question: Total quantity sold all-time for the 'Pantry' reporting group as defined in the catalog. Return an integer.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(od.Quantity) FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID=p.CategoryID WHERE c.CategoryName IN ('Grains/Cereals','Produce')

question: Which customer account generated the highest revenue in 2021? Group by the customer account, not by company name. Return {customer:str, revenue:float}.
gold_sql: SELECT cu.CompanyName, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice*od.Quantity*(1-od.Discount)),2) r FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Customers cu ON cu.CustomerID=o.CustomerID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' GROUP BY cu.CustomerID ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders placed in 2018 have no shipped date recorded? Return an integer.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders o WHERE o.ShippedDate IS NULL AND date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31'

question: Top 3 categories by total quantity sold in 2019, highest first. Return list[{category:str, quantity:int}].
gold_sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, SUM(od.Quantity) q FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID=p.CategoryID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' GROUP BY c.CategoryID ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 3
